name: ahepi-music
description: Tools for making narrated explainer films.

plugins.name: explainer-film
plugins.description: Make narrated, fact-checked explainer films for phone screens in a cinematic 2D+3D look, chapter by chapter, with calculators and a preflight check at every stage; places, sets and props built in Blender get real photographed surfaces, weeds and stones where they really grow, wear and believable construction by themselves, with batched variation rounds on rented cards.

plugins.name: painted-place
plugins.description: Build a place in Blender and bring it into the series' painted blue-hour look in one call, with the old-and-used details made from the place's own shape and from what the camera sees: laid setts and flags, flat stone walls built up into ashlar with dressed windows, real stone grain and photographed timber, bark and sand (free Poly Haven scans), lapped boards, puddles where lights mirror, gutter water, damp, rot, stains, rust, weeds, moss and rubbish, water's edges (wet sand, foam, a tide line, driftwood, mossy banks) and what trees drop; then a blind judge says in plain words whether it has the look and shows what was asked for, and what to fix, once.
